name: In Search of Menara Voidrender

meta.next: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe

summary: Menara Voidrender awaits Horde warlocks ready for deeper study in Ratchet. From the Undercity, they cross the Great Sea to her hilltop refuge above the port.

sections.title: A Summons from the Shadows
sections.body: Kaal Soulreaper watches warlocks grow more skilled in the Undercity. When one outgrows simple hexes and impish thralls, he sends them across the Great Sea for specialized instruction. Demonic control leaves little room for error. A skilled mentor can help a warlock survive the volatile powers of the Nether.

sections.title: The Tower Above Ratchet
sections.body: Strahad Farsan’s tower rises from a high bluff above Ratchet. Away from the scrutiny of city guards, practitioners such as Menara Voidrender teach younger initiates. Warlocks from different backgrounds set aside tribal and political rivalries. The demons they bargain with will consume human, orc, or Forsaken alike if their summoner’s will falters.

faq.answer: Kaal Soulreaper sends warlocks from the Undercity to Menara Voidrender when they have grown skilled enough for advanced instruction.

faq.q: Where can Menara Voidrender be found?
faq.answer: Menara Voidrender lives in the Barrens, in the stone tower above Ratchet with Strahad Farsan.

faq.q: Why must Horde warlocks travel all the way to the Barrens?
faq.answer: Horde warlocks travel to the Barrens for secluded instruction in demonic arts. Menara Voidrender teaches and crafts robes from Strahad’s tower, where warlocks of every background study away from civic and religious authorities.

faq.q: What happens after reaching Menara Voidrender?
faq.answer: Menara acknowledges your training and offers to guide you in making an Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe. The work begins a journey to gather rare and dangerous components across Azeroth.

faq.q: Why do warlocks of different races share knowledge?
faq.answer: Demons show no mercy based on race when a summoner loses control. To survive, warlocks share techniques and protect their craft from disaster.

aliases: who owns the tower in ratchet
faq.answer: Strahad Farsan is a master warlock who keeps the stone tower above Ratchet. It offers practitioners a remote place to learn demonic arts, away from major faction strongholds.

angles.text: As a warlock, you begin advanced practice and can pursue specialized vestments attuned to the Nether’s energies.
As Forsaken, you leave the Undercity’s grim depths for Kalimdor’s sunlit wastes to continue your studies.
As Horde, you see warlock factions maintain a hidden network between Lordaeron and Kalimdor.
